rejected.name: “L” (R on the application of) v HAMPSHIRE COUNTY COUNCIL
rejected.reason: The case concerns judicial review of county council transgender guidance to schools; it cites and distinguishes Lee v Ashers Baking Co Ltd, the very cake case, but does not itself decide any issue about a bakery refusing to ice a same-sex marriage slogan cake.

rejected.name: Ian Sleeper v Commissioner of Police of the Metropolis
rejected.reason: The judgment concerns an appeal against conviction under section 5 of the Public Order Act 1986 for displaying a 'Hate Islam' placard; it merely cites Lee v Ashers Baking in passing to distinguish it, so it does not address the bakery's refusal to ice a same-sex marriage slogan cake.

rejected.name: Attorney General for Bermuda v Roderick Ferguson and others (Bermuda)
rejected.reason: The case concerns whether Bermuda's constitution requires legal recognition of same-sex marriage; Masterpiece Cakeshop appears only as a cited US authority on religious neutrality, not as facts or reasoning of this case.

rejected.name: Peter Waddell Holdco Limited v Bluebell Cars Holding Limited & Ors
rejected.reason: This is a shareholders' unfair dismissal/board dispute (Waddell v Bluebell Cars) concerning misconduct, MDEs and Equality Act harassment at a car group; it has nothing to do with a bakery refusing to bake a same-sex-marriage slogan cake.

rejected.name: Kristie Higgs v Farmor’s School
rejected.reason: Employment discrimination case (religious belief posts on Facebook, suspension and dismissal) with no connection to a bakery's refusal to make a same-sex-marriage slogan cake.

rejected.name: Ngole, R (On the Application Of) v University of Sheffield
rejected.reason: This is the challenge by a Christian student to University of Sheffield disciplinary action over anti-LGBTI social media posts; although it concerns no bakery or cake, it is a leading English authority on Art.9/Art.10 religious speech about same-sex sexuality and is regularly cited in later cases (including Bauer v Minton) about a baker refusing to ice a cake with a same-sex marriage slogan.

rejected.name: Walker v Innospec Limited and others
rejected.reason: An occupational pension survivor's benefit discrimination case concerning para 18 of Sch 9 to the Equality Act 2010 and the Framework Directive; it has nothing to do with a bakery refusing to make a cake bearing a same-sex marriage slogan.

rejected.name: Hearing on the Report of the Chief Justice of Gibraltar (Gibraltar)
